review_rule: Compare the Current learner projection against canonical Natural Unit intent and Chengfeng source semantics. Keep good chapters unchanged. Repair only missing stage shifts, decisive causal bridges, turning points, evaluation boundaries or historical-position anchors. Do not create a second textbook and do not promote every high-frequency fact into the guide.

ch01.reason: Current preserves the causal chain from Western capitalist expansion plus domestic feudal decline to semi-colonial/semi-feudal conditions, main contradictions, historical tasks and the failure of old resistance.

ch02.reason: Current preserves the escalation from peasant resistance to self-strengthening to institutional reform, and explains why each route remained unable to solve the structural national crisis.

ch03.repair: Restore the failure of Qing New Policies and preparatory constitutionalism as a causal bridge: reform failed to save the Qing state, exposed the limits of top-down reform and further narrowed reform space, helping explain revolutionary ascendancy.

ch04.repair: Restore the October Revolution as the missing bridge from New Culture-era ideological liberation to a new revolutionary direction and the further spread of Marxism in China.

ch05.reason: Current already explains why Great Revolution failure forced independent armed struggle, how land revolution and rural bases created a different accumulation path, and why the route matured through error, Long March and Zunyi correction.

ch06.repair: Restore the victory-cause chain and victory marker at S05: national spirit as decisive factor, CPC mainstay role as key, all-national resistance as important weapon, international anti-fascist support, plus Taiwan and Penghu returning to Chinese sovereignty as an important marker of complete victory.

ch07.reason: Current correctly treats the Liberation War as simultaneous military, social and political realignment: peace-democracy attempt, military reversal, second front, democratic-party choice and preparation of the new state.

ch08.repair: Promote The Ten Major Relationships and the Eighth Party Congress from source facts into learner-facing anchors for the shift from completing socialist transition to independently exploring a socialist construction road suited to Chinese conditions.

ch09.repair: Restore rectification of disorder as part of the 1978 transition and promote the 1992 Southern Talks as the later historical anchor that pushed renewed ideological emancipation and reform deepening.

ch10.reason: Current correctly closes History on historical position and long-run transformation rather than turning recent meetings and formulations into a second Xi/New Thought course.

next_gate: Review only compact History Source-root OCR exceptions and declared Suyi deltas. If they add no missing stable teaching value, close S/K and then derive whole-subject formal first-ready timing before Runtime/Evidence generalization.
